personenbelasting.name: Personal Income Tax
personenbelasting.description: A voracious beast that feeds on the gross salary of hard-working citizens. It grows stronger as you earn more, punishing success with relentless efficiency. Often hides behind pre-filled tax forms to lull victims into a false sense of security.

attacks.name: Progressive Bracket Strike
attacks.effect: Halves the value of your well-deserved promotion.

attacks.name: Kafkaesque Paperwork
attacks.effect: Confuses the target. Target loses 3 turns trying to log into Tax-on-Web.

vennootschapsbelasting.name: Corporate Income Tax
vennootschapsbelasting.description: A colossal titan that guards corporate profits. It appears intimidating, but savvy trainers know exactly how to pacify it using a barrage of clever deductions and fiscal tricks.

attacks.name: Audit Roar
attacks.effect: Paralyzes target with fear of a deep fiscal inspection.

attacks.name: Dividend Drain
attacks.effect: Sucks away earnings before they can reach the shareholders.

btw.name: VAT
btw.description: An omnipresent phantom that lurks on every receipt. It silently adds an extra 21% to almost everything you buy, vanishing into the state's coffers before you even notice.

attacks.name: Invisible Surcharge
attacks.effect: Makes the final bill unexpectedly painful.

attacks.name: Quarterly Declaration
attacks.effect: Causes severe stress to self-employed targets every 3 months.

roerende_voorheffing.name: Withholding Tax
roerende_voorheffing.description: A nimble thief that steals 30% of your dividends before they even reach your bank account. It moves so fast that many trainers don't even realize they've been robbed.

attacks.name: Source Snatch
attacks.effect: Intercepts incoming loot and sends it to the Treasury.

onroerende_voorheffing.name: Property Tax
onroerende_voorheffing.description: A territorial behemoth that claims a piece of your home every single year. Its power multiplies wildly depending on the municipality you wander into.

attacks.name: Surcharge Slam
attacks.effect: Multiplies base damage based on the local mayor's mood.

verkeersbelasting.name: Road Tax
verkeersbelasting.description: A fast-moving creature that hunts anyone with a license plate. It specifically targets the horsepower and emissions of your chosen vehicle.

attacks.name: Emission Drain
attacks.effect: Punishes you for not buying a Tesla.

biv.name: Registration Tax
biv.description: A fierce gatekeeper that blocks your path when you try to register a new car. You must pay its ransom before you can legally drive on the road.

attacks.name: Welcome Slap
attacks.effect: Depletes your savings account instantly upon buying a car.

fermette_tax.name: Fermette Tax
fermette_tax.description: A legendary cryptid often talked about by politicians but rarely seen in the wild. It threatens those who built fake farmhouses in rural zones.

attacks.name: Political Bluff
attacks.effect: Scares the target but ultimately does absolutely nothing.

accijnzen_brandstoffen.name: Fuel Accises
accijnzen_brandstoffen.description: A parasitic entity attached to every fuel pump. It drinks your money every time you fill up your tank, getting fatter while your wallet gets lighter.

attacks.name: Pump Shock
attacks.effect: Inflicts pure psychological damage at the gas station.

nettarieven.name: Grid Tariffs
nettarieven.description: A shadowy network monster that lurks inside your electricity bill. No one truly understands its anatomy, but it consumes a massive portion of your energy costs.

attacks.name: Capacity Peak
attacks.effect: Strikes you down if you dare to iron clothes while baking.

kijk_en_luistergeld.name: TV & Radio Tax
kijk_en_luistergeld.description: An archaic ghost of the past that haunted your television and radio sets. It demanded tribute just for the privilege of receiving broadcast waves.

attacks.name: Static Interference
attacks.effect: An annoying buzz that slowly drains your patience.

zorgpremie.name: Care Premium
zorgpremie.description: The sneaky evolution of the TV Tax. It masquerades as a benevolent healing spell, but is actually a mandatory flat tax forced upon every adult in Flanders.

attacks.name: Flat Fee Slap
attacks.effect: Takes a fixed amount every year, regardless of your income.

erfbelasting.name: Inheritance Tax
erfbelasting.description: The ultimate grim reaper of taxes. It waits patiently at the end of your life journey to harvest a chunk of everything you've ever saved.

attacks.name: Grave Robbery
attacks.effect: Claims a massive portion of the estate if passed to a non-relative.

tob.name: Stock Exchange Tax
tob.description: A micro-parasite that attaches to every trade. It nibbles tiny bits of your capital every time you buy or sell a stock.

attacks.name: Transaction Nibble
attacks.effect: Causes chip damage on every single accumulating fund you touch.

effectenrekeningtaks.name: Securities Tax
effectenrekeningtaks.description: A legendary beast that only hunts the very wealthy. If your portfolio exceeds 1 million euros, it swoops down and takes a bite every year.

attacks.name: Wealth Bite
attacks.effect: Slowly drains large portfolios. Ignores defense.

registratierechten.name: Registration Duties
registratierechten.description: A massive golem guarding the entrance to homeownership. It demands a massive lump sum of gold before allowing you to pass and buy a house.

attacks.name: Barrier Slam
attacks.effect: Crushes your budget for renovations.

turteltaks.name: Turtel Tax
turteltaks.description: An extinct energy vampire named after a former minister. It famously drained the wallets of Flemish households to pay for green energy certificates before being struck down by courts.

attacks.name: Biomass Drain
attacks.effect: An unblockable fee that you had to pay just for having an electricity connection.

kadastraal_inkomen.name: Cadastral Income
kadastraal_inkomen.description: An ancient spell cast in 1975 that froze the rental value of all Belgian homes in time. Every year, bureaucrats apply a confusing multiplier to it to calculate your real tax.

attacks.name: Indexation Boost
attacks.effect: Inflates a tiny number into a massive tax base.

notionele_interestaftrek.name: Notional Interest
notionele_interestaftrek.description: A highly complex defensive aura used by multinational corporations. It allows them to deduct phantom interest on money they never actually borrowed.

attacks.name: Phantom Deduction
attacks.effect: Reduces taxable profits to zero without spending a dime.

tax_shelter.name: Tax Shelter
tax_shelter.description: A magical umbrella that protects corporate profits from the tax rain, as long as the money is dumped into Belgian movie productions or video games.

attacks.name: Cinematic Shield
attacks.effect: Absorbs tax damage by producing a weird arthouse film.

flexi_jobs.name: Flexi-Job
flexi_jobs.description: A rare status effect that lets you work a side hustle completely tax-free. Originally meant just for pouring beers, now available for almost everything.

attacks.name: Untaxed Overtime
attacks.effect: Generates pure, untaxed cash without feeding the government.

indexsprong.name: Index Skip
indexsprong.description: A devastating ultimate attack used by right-wing governments. It freezes the automatic wage indexation, permanently deleting a chunk of purchasing power from every worker.

attacks.name: Wage Freeze
attacks.effect: Skips your level up, keeping your stats exactly the same while enemies get stronger.

auteursrechten.name: Copyright Regime
auteursrechten.description: Once an overpowered glitch that allowed IT consultants to pay only 7.5% tax. The devs patched it in 2023, nerfing its effectiveness and restricting it to actual artists.

attacks.name: Creative Accounting
attacks.effect: Converts heavily taxed income into lightly taxed royalties.

belastingvrije_som.name: Tax-Free Allowance
belastingvrije_som.description: Your basic starter shield. It protects the first chunk of your earnings from the Personal Income Tax monster. Having kids levels up this shield significantly.

attacks.name: Basic Shield
attacks.effect: Deflects the first few attacks from income tax completely.
